reason: Renames build output extension from .prod.js to .min.js across many modules/themes and changes ResourceManagementOptionsConfiguration.cs references plus script dependency chains (e.g. bootstrap-select now depends-on='admin' instead of 'bootstrap'), so any downstream theme/module that references the old .prod.js filenames or relies on the previous resource dependency graph will break at runtime.
